notablePrerequisites:
Wind Zendikon attached to Thawing Glaciers.
Thawing Glaciers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Thawing Glaciers by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Coralhelm.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Thawing Glaciers.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
